info.brief: The light options the render script forwards into shader uniform constants. Scripts
info.description:
The light options the render script forwards into shader uniform constants. Scripts
such as `light_setting.script` and `sun.script` write them, and `light.update` and
the render script read them every frame. Vector fields are mutated in place
(`constants.fog.x = 20`); assigning a new value to a field goes through a cast, since
a namespace import is read-only.

elements.name: clear_color
elements.brief: The color that clears the default render target, which is the background color. RGB in `0`..`1`.
elements.description: The color that clears the default render target, which is the background color. RGB in `0`..`1`.

elements.name: fog
elements.brief: The minimum and maximum Z in camera view space between which the fog starts and ends, in `x` and `y`.
elements.description: The minimum and maximum Z in camera view space between which the fog starts and ends, in `x` and `y`.

elements.name: ambient
elements.brief: The ambient color, added after every light source is blended. `w` is the maximum value of each final color component.
elements.description: The ambient color, added after every light source is blended. `w` is the maximum value of each final color component.

elements.name: fog_color
elements.brief: The fog color, usually the clear color. `w` is the fog density from `0` to `1`, where `0` is the densest.
elements.description: The fog color, usually the clear color. `w` is the fog density from `0` to `1`, where `0` is the densest.

elements.name: lights
elements.brief: The light sources, their world positions and colors. Only the first
elements.description:
The light sources, their world positions and colors. Only the first
`light_and_shadows.max_lights` reach the shader; missing ones are sent as zero
vectors.

elements.name: cam_position
elements.brief: The camera world position, which the shader uses for specular light. `light.update` copies it from `light.cam_position`.
elements.description: The camera world position, which the shader uses for specular light. `light.update` copies it from `light.cam_position`.

elements.name: cam_look_at_position
elements.brief: The point the camera looks at, the center of the shadow projection. `light.update` copies it from `light.cam_look_at`.
elements.description: The point the camera looks at, the center of the shadow projection. `light.update` copies it from `light.cam_look_at`.

elements.name: sun_position
elements.brief: The sun position, the one light source that casts shadows.
elements.description: The sun position, the one light source that casts shadows.

elements.name: sun_dir
elements.brief: The sun direction, used for shadow casting with a perspective projection.
elements.description: The sun direction, used for shadow casting with a perspective projection.

elements.name: shadow_color
elements.brief: The inverted shadow color, subtracted where shadows fall. `light_and_shadows.update` sets `w` to `1` when `light_and_shadows.shadow` is on and `0` when it is off.
elements.description: The inverted shadow color, subtracted where shadows fall. `light_and_shadows.update` sets `w` to `1` when `light_and_shadows.shadow` is on and `0` when it is off.

elements.name: cam_z
elements.brief: The camera Z coordinate, the distance from the focus point. `light.update` copies it from `light.cam_z`.
elements.description: The camera Z coordinate, the distance from the focus point. `light.update` copies it from `light.cam_z`.

elements.name: focus_range
elements.brief: How wide the depth-of-field focus zone is. `light_and_shadows.dof` sets it from `focus_range`.
elements.description: How wide the depth-of-field focus zone is. `light_and_shadows.dof` sets it from `focus_range`.

elements.name: near_z
elements.brief: The camera near Z plane. The reference render script reads it from the camera while `light_and_shadows.get_far_near_z_from_camera` is `true`.
elements.description: The camera near Z plane. The reference render script reads it from the camera while `light_and_shadows.get_far_near_z_from_camera` is `true`.

elements.name: far_z
elements.brief: The camera far Z plane. The reference render script reads it from the camera while `light_and_shadows.get_far_near_z_from_camera` is `true`.
elements.description: The camera far Z plane. The reference render script reads it from the camera while `light_and_shadows.get_far_near_z_from_camera` is `true`.

properties.name: position
properties.brief: The world position. `w` carries the spotlight smoothness.
properties.description: The world position. `w` carries the spotlight smoothness.

properties.name: color
properties.brief: The color. `w` is the power after distance attenuation.
properties.description: The color. `w` is the power after distance attenuation.

properties.name: direction
properties.brief: The spotlight direction; `w` above `0` turns the spotlight on. `light_and_shadows.update` sends a zero vector when it is absent.
properties.description: The spotlight direction; `w` above `0` turns the spotlight on. `light_and_shadows.update` sends a zero vector when it is absent.

properties.name: distance
properties.brief: The squared distance from the point the camera looks at.
properties.description: The squared distance from the point the camera looks at.
